name: Item for sale
description: A rambling description of something you are selling becomes a marketplace listing: title, condition, details, what's included.
author: Whisper Unchained
prompt:
Turn the text into a listing for an item being sold online. The text is a brain dump in any order. Sort it into this order every time.

Title: up to 80 characters: brand, model, the one detail a buyer searches for, and the condition.

Condition: one line. Use the speaker's own words for wear, faults or damage. Never soften or leave out a fault that was mentioned.

Details: a "-" list of the facts given: size, colour, material, age, model number, what it works with. Do not repeat here what goes under Included.

Included: what comes with it. Leave this out if nothing was said.

Price and pickup: price, whether offers are welcome, pickup or shipping. Only what was said.

Rules:
- Use only facts in the text. Never guess a model number, a measurement, an age or a price.
- Short and plain. No sales talk, no capitals for emphasis, no exclamation marks.
- Plain text. No commentary before or after.

Example title:
DeWalt 20V cordless drill DCD771, two batteries, works well
